newsitem.title: USA: Multimedia Games signs two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Multimedia Games signs two contracts.

text.p: Multimedia Games Inc said Friday it signed two new contracts with Indian tribes for the company's MegaMania bingo game.

The company said it installed 24 units at the Lucky Eagle gaming facility in Rochester, Wash., which is owned and oeprated by the Confederated Tribe of the Chehalis Indians. It installed 16 units at the Seven Cedars facility at Sequim, Wash., which is owned and operated by Jamestown S'Kallam Indian Tribe.
Multimedia Games said both facilities were already participants in the company's closed circuit satellite broadcast MegaBingo game.
